text:
Four thermometers, with their bulbs painted different colours, are placed at equal distances from
a radiant heater.
Which thermometer shows the slowest temperature rise when the heater is first switched on?
A
matt black
B
matt white
C
shiny black
D
shiny white
subject: Physics
